academicJudgment.decision: Retain external-programme-unresolved after the Stage2 bounded-materiality test. The missing evidence concerns which specific current biological/cognitive/computational methods, integrated neural practicals and culminating research are required, and their defining weight, not just formal credits. No applicable current unit-content/core table has been inspected. A qualitative recruitment mission cannot independently establish a stable substantial bachelor-level academic core; substituting the detailed archived programme would change the assessed cohort. This is a case-specific scope failure, not a zero-EC rule or approval quota.

courseReview.actualReview: Opened the readable151-course current workbook. courseReview.closestStrengths: Brain&Behavior, Neurobiology, HigherOrderFunctions and Perception&Action supply actual neural structure/signalling, comparative brain anatomy, cognitive experiments and neural sensory/action inquiry. Molecular biology/biochemistry, experimental statistics/meta-analysis, life-science laboratory, Python, calculus, linear algebra, probability, machine learning and deep learning contribute real biological and quantitative methods. Pharmacology explicitly adds nervous-system drug applications and a psychoactive-drug experimental-design proposal.
courseReview.limits: Artificial neural networks are not biophysical brain models. The molecular/microbial laboratory does not establish neural recording or EEG/BCI practice. General physiology/body anatomy does not establish specialist neuroanatomy. Introductory imaging/electrophysiology discussion is not sustained instrument training. Disease/lifestyle/ageing examples do not guarantee a brain-specific project. Pharmacology’s proposal is not a completed psychoactive-drug experiment.
